title: Start Colima service in bootstrap.sh
description: Brewfile installs colima but bootstrap never started the service, so docker had no daemon after a fresh bootstrap.

title: Configure SSH keys with Touch ID via Keychain
description: Set up SSH key passphrases stored in macOS Keychain with Touch ID unlock. Use --apple-use-keychain with ssh-add. Configure in ~/.ssh/config with AddKeysToAgent and UseKeychain options. Do this when restoring SSH backup.

title: Configure VS Code Settings Sync via GitHub
description: VS Code is installed and signed into GitHub, but Settings Sync status is unclear. Need to verify sync is active and configure what syncs (settings, keybindings, extensions). No 'Turn On' option in Command Palette — may already be enabled by default.
notes:
Installed vscodevim extension for vim keybindings. This should sync via Settings Sync once configured.
Set color theme to GitHub Dark Dimmed (requires GitHub Theme extension).
Install Python extension (by Microsoft) for Python language support.
Install Claude extension for VS Code.
Disable GitHub extension (built-in or otherwise).
Install Ruff extension for Python linting/formatting.
Add VS Code settings for Ruff as default Python formatter with format-on-save: "[python]": { "editor.defaultFormatter": "charliermarsh.ruff", "editor.formatOnSave": true }

title: Fix Alfred 'lol' lock keyword not working
description: After pointing Alfred preferences to ~/.dotfiles/alfred, the lockKeyword=lol setting in the plist is not being picked up. May need to quit/relaunch Alfred or investigate the local hash path.
